t: A browser 3D design and AR tool with a shared class workspace.
steps: Find the Vectary education program and confirm it is still offered.
Do not confuse Vectary with Vecteezy, which is a different company.
Read the privacy policy and check its under 16 data rule against your students.
Register as a teacher and set up a class workspace.
Ask the vendor about the current cost.
Try a sample exercise before class.
